description: Every Cloud Run service, job, and revision -- plus a deployment gate, exposure audit, and config diff that gcloud never shipped.

novel_features.name: Cross-project service inventory
novel_features.description: List Cloud Run services across multiple GCP projects in a single unified table.

novel_features.name: Zombie revision sweeper
novel_features.description: Delete old revisions that are not serving any traffic, keeping only the N most recent.

novel_features.name: Traffic split inspector
novel_features.description: Show the current traffic split across revisions with image tag and deploy timestamp in one table.

novel_features.name: Execution outcome summary
novel_features.description: Show a per-execution summary of a Cloud Run Job with succeeded/failed task counts and duration.

novel_features.name: Public exposure audit
novel_features.description: List all services in a project that are publicly accessible via allUsers or allAuthenticatedUsers IAM bindings.

novel_features.name: Wait-for-traffic
novel_features.description: Block until a specific revision reaches a target traffic percentage -- a CI/CD gate primitive.

novel_features.name: Revision config diff
novel_features.description: Show a field-by-field diff between two revisions: image, CPU/memory, scaling config, and env var key names.

novel_features.name: IAM policy diff
novel_features.description: Compare the current IAM policy of a service against a saved snapshot to detect added or removed bindings.
